transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, October 1. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Will take China help if Centre and Manipur fail to act: Naga group. Tangkhul Naga leaders expressed concern over the safety of civilians living in vulnerable border areas. They criticized both the Manipur state government and the central government for their inaction. Recent violence has led to the deaths of multiple Naga civilians, raising significant fears among the affected communities. The group urged for immediate protective measures to prevent seeking assistance from neighboring countries. 'Receiving necessary medical attention': Embassy updates on Indian Flydubai pilot. A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a serious incident that required an emergency landing. Following a cockpit altercation, one pilot was arrested and investigated by Saudi authorities. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the situation was managed and the safety of passengers was prioritized. Warplanes were scrambled in response to potential hijacking fears but were later stood down. In 2018, Musk gave $480,350 for Flint school filters; students drink from fountains. Flint Community Schools has installed new water filtration systems across its schools and administrative building. Students were previously reliant on bottled water for drinking due to contamination concerns. Testing confirmed that the new systems effectively removed lead and harmful bacteria from the water supply. Although drinking stations are now available, bottled water will continue to be provided throughout the school year. Bombs without brakes? US-China AI race may be harder to control than the nuclear one. The people building artificial intelligence keep reaching for the same comparison. Billionaire Elon Musk has called AI "far more dangerous than nukes." Anthropic boss Dario Amodei describes the most powerful models as "weaponisable nuclear materials." Sam Altman, when asked how AI could be policed, often points to the International Atomic Energy Agency(IAEA), the world's nuclear watchdog. 5 money changes in Oct: Bulk FD rates, UPI MDR, SBI ATM limit cut, LPG KYC and more. The money changes include a reduction in the number of free ATM transactions for certain State Bank of India (SBI) salary account customers, new disclosure norms for interest rates on bulk fixed deposits (FDs), revised charges under the National Pension System (NPS) and mandatory Aadhaar authentication for receiving LPG subsidies. Trump announces $200bn South Korean investment in US, $54bn for Alaska LNG. South Korea is making waves with a monumental commitment of $200 billion toward US energy endeavors. This ambitious plan encompasses a critical liquefied natural gas project in Alaska and a gas-fired power facility in Texas. Moreover, investments in eight nuclear reactors across the nation are also underway. These strategic ventures stem from a $350 billion trade agreement signed in November 2025, reinforcing economic cooperation between South Korea and the US. 'India is proud of Captain Machchhar': PM Modi hails pilot who saved 180 lives. Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday hailed Captain Smit Machchhar as a "HERO" for his courage in protecting passengers despite being seriously injured during an altercation in the cockpit of a Flydubai flight travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Oil prices stay flat as markets weigh US-Iran talks and Middle East supply. Despite slight changes in oil prices today, Brent and WTI Crude both experienced gains in their last trading sessions. Investors remain alert to the evolving US-Iran negotiations, as their outcomes are likely to sway market dynamics. Furthermore, Saudi Arabia has restarted oil tanker loading activities via its East-West Pipeline. Recent statistics presented a mixed bag regarding US crude inventory levels, influencing market attitudes. 'Might as well disband you': SC raps UP police for cover-up job. Supreme Court on Wednesday slammed Uttar Pradesh police for not naming the accused in a road accident case despite the complainant catching him on the spot and handing him over to police. Congress to replace Warring as Punjab chief; Singla seen as frontrunner for post. Decision backed by feedback from Pilot's meetings with state functionaries Man who owned historic home 51 years keeps it after ASU drops takeover bid. Arizona State University withdrew its eminent domain lawsuit against the historic Louis Emerson House to preserve the property. The decision followed widespread public opposition and a successful campaign led by John Young and Barry Schwartz. They generated substantial support through a petition that collected over 12,000 signatures. The university had filed the lawsuit seeking to acquire the property for a medical campus. Ohio farmer with $1m medical debt sold land after officials blocked solar lease. In Ohio, farmer Wayne Greier's financial struggles intensified when a planned solar project fell through due to local resistance and new rules, leaving his family's renewable energy plans in jeopardy. Compounded by $1 million in medical debt from recent health issues, Greier was forced to offload land and equipment, jeopardizing his farming business. He has emerged as an advocate for farmers' property rights to help protect others from similar hardships.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Free Press Anti-Drug Seminar In Bhopal Calls For Mass Movement Against Addiction. Free Press's 'Stay Away From Drugs' seminar in Bhopal brought together public representatives, police officials and experts to call for collective action against addiction. CM Mohan Yadav Pushes Private IT Parks, Semiconductor Industry Growth In Madhya Pradesh. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav has called for encouraging private-sector IT parks in Madhya Pradesh and supporting Jabalpur entrepreneurs interested in the semiconductor industry. BMC To Rework Sealing Action As Bhopal Master Plan Draft Opens One-Year Regularisation Window. BMC will rework its sealing strategy after the draft Bhopal Development Plan 2047 proposed a one-year window for eligible non-residential activities in residential areas to seek regularisation. Indore-Manmad Rail Line Gets Major Push As rupees 4,930.91 Crore Tender Floated. The Indore-Manmad new rail line project has moved forward with Central Railway floating a rupees 4,930.91 crore tender for the 72.66-km Mhow-Gyaraspurkhedi stretch. Heavy rain disrupts life in MP; schools shut in Bhopal. Bhagirathpura Water Contamination Probe Flags Pipeline Lapses, Missing Sewer Records In Indore. The judicial inquiry into Indore's Bhagirathpura water contamination incident has flagged serious pipeline maintenance lapses and held executive engineer Sanjeev Kumar Srivastava responsible. Ex-IAS Officer Found Murdered At Bhopal Home, New House Help Key Suspect. Throat slit, caretaker missing: Ex-IAS officer found dead in Bhopal home. Congress Protests In Indore, Seeks CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Resignation Over SIR. Congress workers staged a protest in Indore demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation amid the row over the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Madhya Pradesh High Court Sets Aside 'Kumbh Girl' Monalisa's Birth Date Correction. The Madhya Pradesh High Court's Indore bench has set aside an order correcting 'Kumbh girl' Monalisa Bhosle's birth date, ruling that she should have been heard before the change. EaseMyTrip expands into electric mobility with Bhopal bus rollout, targets 5,000-unit annual capacity. Rajat Patidar Out, Shubham Sharma To Lead Madhya Pradesh In Ranji Trophy 2026-27. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. DA hike after August inflation data: Will dearness allowance rise to 65 percent ? How it may impact salaries of Level 1-10 central government employees. In August 2026, the Labour Bureau revealed a rise in the All India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers. This uptick translates into an estimated Dearness Allowance of 65 percent , signaling a welcome increase for many employees. As the central government regularly adjusts DA based on this data, employees may soon enjoy significant salary enhancements, with official announcements typically coinciding with festive periods. NPS Diwas 2026: Start at 25 or 40? Expert explains how your age can change your retirement savings strategy. Starting early, increasing contributions with income and knowing the retirement corpus you need can make NPS more effective as part of a long-term retirement plan, experts say. Medicine shop owner deposits rupees 2.47 crore cash in bank account, gets income tax notice for unexplained cash; wins case in ITAT Delhi for this reason. Mr Kumar, a medicine shop owner had deposited rupees 2.47 crore cash in his bank account during demonetisation period, he got an unexplained cash income tax notice. After a long legal fight he won the case in ITAT Delhi. This article explains how. Kisan Vikas Patra: Want to transfer, pledge or prematurely close your account? Here's what the rules say. The Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) is a 115-month investment scheme designed for Indian citizens aged 10 and over, allowing deposits starting from rupees 1,000. Here's a look at the rules to transfer, pledge or prematurely close your account... NPS Swasthya: rupees 1 lakh to rupees 30 lakh , Check health insurance cover, deductibles the scheme likely provides. PFRDA plans to introduce the NPS Swasthya health-focused pension product after successful testing. Here's a look at what we can expect, the deductibles and likely healthcare insurance cover the product may provide... Only rupees 2 lakh was paid by Star Health against a claim of rupees 4.28 lakh, citing a sub-limit clause: Here's why the policyholder won rupees 2.28 lakh more. A recent case involving Star Health and Allied Insurance highlights the complexities of health insurance policies with disease-specific sub-limits. After a renewal and an increased sum insured, a claim for cerebrovascular accident treatment faced limitations due to alleged sub-limits. The consumer commission found deficiencies in service, raising important questions about transparency and policy terms in health insurance contracts. RBI's new bulk FD rules from October 1: What changes for investors? Experts explain. The revised RBI framework is aimed at making bulk SGB premature redemption dates in October 2026: Check tranche-wise dates and request deadlines. Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB): In a recent announcement, the Reserve Bank of India disclosed the premature redemption dates for Sovereign Gold Bonds, spanning from October 2026 to March 2027. Investors should be aware of the allocated timeframes for submitting their redemption applications. Side hustle versus cost-cutting: Should you earn more or curb your expenses? Start by checking. Shah Rukh Khan's mother advised him to earn more rather than limit his expenses. What should you do? Fee on UPI P2M payments: How this "small" 0.4 percent fee can take a bigger bite out of your money. Starting from October 15, 2026, a new 0.4 percent transaction fee will be applied to UPI payments exceeding rupees 2,000, while lower amounts and peer-to-peer transfers will still be free. As some merchants may choose to adjust prices accordingly, customers should stay vigilant, checking for any surcharges at checkout to ensure they understand all costs involved. Transparency and quality of service will be vital as these changes are implemented. Wealth creation: 55 crore UPI users versus 6 crore investors , to increase participation India can learn from global markets. EY's latest report, global experience suggests wealth participation expands when investing is embedded into financial behavior, supported by trust, enabled by technology and delivered through simple, accessible experiences. Lived in mother's house, paid for construction: Why Delhi High Court rejected son's plea for ownership rights. The Delhi HC ruling is relevant to families where parents own a house but allow their children or other relatives to live there. It distinguishes between the right to reside in a family property and a legally established ownership interest. Mother nominated son in her savings bank a/c, but both died, father faced long delay in getting funds; Consumer Commission orders rupees 10,000 compensation. Ernakulam, Kerala: Husband faced challenges and long delay in accessing late wife's savings bank account as nominee died; Consumer commission orders bank to pay rupees 10,000 compensation for delay Inherited family gold? How to prove ownership and source of jewellery to Income Tax Department. The Kolkata Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled in favour of the assessee in a case, underscoring the importance of supporting claims about inherited jewellery with credible and consistent evidence. Has government increased SSY, PPF, NSC, other small savings schemes' interest rates for October-December 2026 quarter?. The Finance Ministry has decided to keep interest rates unchanged for small savings schemes like SSY, PPF for the Oct-Dec 2026 quarter, amid the backdrop of rising inflation and higher Government Securities bond yields. Several small savings schemes already offer rates above 7 percent . Building corpus for your startup on the side? Here's what you should do before you save for business expenses. Starting a startup requires careful financial planning. Founders should prioritise family security by creating a safety fund, protecting savings for family goals, and building a startup fund. PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana decoded: Salaried employees earning up to rupees 1 lakh/month can get DBT benefit, Check details. The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY), launched in August 2025, offers employment linked incentives for salaried workers from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027, with an allocation of rupees 99,446 crore to boost first-time employment and encourage employers. New rules from October 2026: SBI ATM transactions, UPI MDR, bulk FD rates, NPS and LPG subsidy changes. October 2026 will bring several changes that could impact bank customers, Unified Payment Interface (UPI) merchants, National Pension System (NPS) subscribers and domestic Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG) consumers.
